title: Timing Measurement
text: Measure period, frequency, duty cycle, rise time, fall time, and delay of a signal, 2 inputs, 6 outputs; {Period} sets the measure period of input signal, {Frequency} sets the measure frequency of input signal, {Rise Time} sets the measure rise time of input signal, {Fall Time} sets the measure fall time of input signal, {Duty Cycle} sets the measure duty cycle of input signal, {Delay} sets the measure delay of input signal, {Use same reference threshold for all measurements} uses the same reference threshold for measuring all timing, {Reference threshold (V)} sets the reference threshold used for measuring timing, {Input range (V)} sets the peak-to-peak value of input signal, {Type} sets the input threshold levels to measure rise/fall times and {Test threshold (V)} sets the threshold voltage level in test signal used to measure. Values come from the instance.
